result: The track width, straight cross-axis relief, and upper-arrow silhouette agree. The clear differences are the lighter arrow interior in the narrow attachment and its visibly separate short thumb shaft; the large screenshot masks the relevant lower GTK2 region, so its thumb length/position cannot be compared there. R758 supplies a measured short-thumb sample from the actual SR10.4 VM and corrects R757's earlier limitation that only a nearly-full VM thumb was available. Its center uses the trough role, while the screenshot's brighter center shade is not enough to establish the intended role without state/palette provenance.
action: No theme code or palette changed in this comparison. Keep the GTK2 adaptation on the active authorized item; inspect the thumb and exposed trough as separate components before changing either. Do not treat the arrow tint discrepancy as a geometry defect or copy static RGB values from the attachment.
